Can you suggest some history books written by David Howarth?

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Ship
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: An engaging account of the life of a British warship during World War II.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Great War at Sea
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A detailed examination of naval warfare during the First World War.

gpt-4o-mini.title: We Die Alone
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A gripping historical account by David Howarth, this book chronicles the harrowing journey of a Norwegian resistance fighter during World War II, highlighting themes of survival and bravery in the face of adversity.

gemma2:9b.title: The British Empire in the World 1900-1945
gemma2:9b.explanation: Explores British imperial policy and its global impact during the early 20th century.

gemma2:9b.title: The Age of Crisis, 1914-1939
gemma2:9b.explanation: Analyzes the political and social upheaval that shaped the interwar period.

gemma2:9b.title: The English Empire: A Concise History
gemma2:9b.explanation: Provides a comprehensive overview of British imperial history from its origins to its decline.
